qualification_scope.normalization: Only authority/runtime evidence identifiers, message identifiers, and control-plane timestamps are authority-specific. Business Task/Run/Subtask/Attempt, accounting, quota, continuation, Memory, and Artifact projections are compared without normalization.
qualification_scope.same_dag_contract: Both authorities admit the deterministic research/analysis/join DAG; safety exceptions below are outcome-shape differences, not different task plans.
qualification_scope.overall_rule: qualified_with_documented_exceptions means the exact equality claim is limited to scenarios marked parity_pass=true; every other scenario is retained as an explicit safety boundary.

documented_safety_exceptions.difference: Legacy eagerly terminalizes queued siblings and the blocked join. Managed convergence preserves an untouched pre-dispatch sibling as READY/BLOCKED until its dedicated pre-dispatch release path runs.
documented_safety_exceptions.safe_projection: Task failure/error, triggering failed Run/Subtask, target Attempt accounting, budget, quota, Memory/Artifact, and business continuation evidence match.

documented_safety_exceptions.difference: The managed known-terminal convergence slice deliberately rejects user cancellation as a later cancellation-barrier responsibility; legacy cancellation completes through RunExecutionService.
documented_safety_exceptions.safe_projection: Managed cancellation intent is fail-closed and does not rewrite the target to success or failure.

documented_safety_exceptions.difference: The fixture qualifies the WAITING_APPROVAL boundary only. Managed pre-dispatch release preserves READY/BLOCKED sibling state while legacy eagerly terminalizes it; resume is not claimed by this report.
documented_safety_exceptions.safe_projection: Task waiting/error, successful target Run/Subtask/Attempt accounting, budget, quota, Memory/Artifact, and business continuation evidence match.

documented_safety_exceptions.difference: There is no legacy equivalent. Managed parks the crossed outcome and retains the target Run in RUNNING/reconciliation-safe state.
documented_safety_exceptions.safe_projection: The managed path proves that OUTCOME_UNKNOWN is not rewritten as success or failure and records no accepted terminal observation.

runtime_conformance.method: The parameterized contract runs the deterministic LangGraph and generic subprocess adapters. Capability-conditional nodes are only asserted when the adapter descriptor advertises the capability; skipped capability branches are not treated as passes.

evidence.capability_condition: adapter fixture selects subprocess; cancel branch requires descriptor cancellation support
